_description: E-076a, the CONTROL arm: the cone-native codec (the encoder that reads a 30-day dependency cone of past measurements around a pixel instead of one snapshot of it) trained on the first tensor that covers the whole globe, with the ocean's interior entering the way it always has — as the gridded Argo depth column, one 1-degree map per month, served to every 0.25-degree cell inside it and missing at five pentads in six. Everything about the model is f4r3-cone-7M-lag0drop: the same 7-million-parameter geometry (Perceiver, 64 latents x width 256 x 6 blocks, 8 heads, decoder 256 x 2, code width 32, batch 256), the same 30-day inner window, the same masking plan in which a hidden channel is hidden only at the present-day patch while its past stays visible, hidden dots come only from the recent-lag band and the 90-degree bearing wedge, and the anchor part of the loss scores only the channels that were actually hidden. Two things change and both are properties of the DATA rather than of the model: the tensor is family 7 (721 x 1440 cells pole to pole, three co-registered groups at two resolutions, land observed as well as ocean) instead of the North Atlantic window, and every dot token now carries two extra numbers describing what kind of measurement it is — the local count of raw observations and the spatial and temporal FOOTPRINT of the value, so a 1-degree monthly average and a point profile are no longer indistinguishable to the model. The snapshot twin is off: this run is the control for the family-8 arm, not for the cone-versus-snapshot question that f4r3 answered, and training a second codec in the same job would double a global run for nothing. NOTE for whoever scores this arm: E-076 section 5.1's common target is the nearest REAL Argo profile, so reading it needs the observation store even here, where the store is not an input — add cone_argo_store family8_argo_l0 and cone_profile_k 0 to this recipe and the trainer will pull the store, leave the gridded column exactly as it is, and score the same 32 numbers the family-8 arm is scored on.
_provenance: Written 2026-09-07 for E-076a, the ablation of ml/plans/E076_family8_nearest_observations.md section 5. The geometry and the masking plan are f4r3-cone-7M-lag0drop's, which was designed 2026-09-03 after #539 measured hidden-dot MSE 1.001 — predict-the-mean — on 64% of the loss weight. The tensor is the family-7 build published by build_family7 under recipe f7l0; the footprint fields are E-076 section 2.6, added at Chris's request on 2026-09-07.
